name: Imagine AI
long_description:
Imagine AI is a research and software company reverse engineering modern B2B growth, starting with LinkedIn.

As companies get more automated, more of B2B growth will happen between agents, and the companies that connect will compound each other's output. We're building the connective layer between them. We start with content because it's still the fastest way to build B2B relationships at scale.

Today our content agent decides what your team should post based on data from 1M+ people (who posts what, who engages, where they work and how they're connected). It drafts the posts and graphics, schedules them for your execs and company page, and maps engagement back to your pipeline.

Rippling, MarqVision, Slash, Corgi and Fondo use Imagine AI. Customers have generated $40M in revenue, 100M impressions and 14,341 MQLs.

Free public benchmark of how 1,000+ B2B companies and their execs perform on LinkedIn: https://benchmark.useimagine.ai
one_liner: We reverse engineer B2B growth, starting with LinkedIn.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Sky Yang is the Co-founder & CEO of Imagine AI.

He was the youngest-ever elected Student Body President at UC San Diego, where he led 32,000 students and successfully raised $150M for university infrastructure improvement. He also founded the nonprofit Break the Outbreak, scaling it to a 400-person organization operating in 53 cities/18 States.

founders.title: Co-founder
founders.founder_bio:
Neo Lee co-founded Imagine AI in 2025, which now serves 50+ B2B companies including MongoDB, Rippling, Slash, and Corgi Insurance.

He was previously a founding engineer at startups backed by MiraclePlus, Mysten Labs, and the SUI Foundation, and researched non-cooperative stochastic games at UC Berkeley under Prof. Alan Hammond, where he proved a previously open equilibrium-threshold result in stake-governed tug-of-war games.

launches.title: Imagine AI - You never need to go on LinkedIn again
launches.tagline: The data-driven agent that runs LinkedIn for high-growth companies
launches.body:
Hey YC! We're Sky and Neo from Imagine AI (F25). Today we're launching the Imagine AI agent V2. Imagine is your teammate with its own computer and browser that runs LinkedIn for your founders, your team and your company page. It can take care of your entire company’s LinkedIn from one agent, it can post, graphics, comments, connection requests and messages, all from one chat.

<https://youtu.be/cxdC1jJ3tR8>

## TL;DR

* Talk to it in Slack or in our app like a teammate
* It writes your posts and makes on-brand graphics based on what's working in your space
* It tells you who engaged, which of them matter (buyers, talent, partners) and reaches out once you approve

**Ask:** YC founders get 50% off the first month and the setup fee waived. Email [sky@imagineai.me](mailto:sky@imagineai.me) with "YC Deal - \[company\]", or book a demo at <https://useimagine.ai> and we'll make sure your company has Imagine taking care of your LinkedIn.

## The problem

LinkedIn is the bridge between companies. It's high value, but doing it well takes a lot of time and effort.

* **Nobody knows what works:** Founders and team should be posting, but most Series A and B companies have a few growth/marketers at best, so people post whenever they remember
* **Underused:** Most B2B companies communicate on LinkedIn, but it’s always something on the backlog. There is no clear and easy way to do LinkedIn for the entire company.

We spent almost two years on this problem of how B2B growth actually works and how companies actually communicate (especially in the future as we move to a closed loop production web), and we are starting with LinkedIn.

## How it works

* **It knows what works.** It's built on our research on how content distributes, like our benchmark at [benchmark.useimagine.ai](https://benchmark.useimagine.ai) with millions of B2B engagement data points. Our study of 20,000+ YC founder posts found engagement follows a log normal distribution, meaning consistent posting of optimal content will help accounts get more value out of LinkedIn: Companies with 4+ people posting consistently get about 7x the reach per follower

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=125452&key=user_uploads/1654391/67badcae-82c1-4c48-a96a-80286d17b504)

* **It learns your company.** Website, deck, past posts, brand kit and every teammate's voice, in one shared memory

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=125452&key=user_uploads/1654391/1b029660-aa5b-4ba5-8cfb-7ea4ce7ae18e)

* **It does the work from its own computer.** Posts, graphics, tags, comments, connection requests and messages on demand

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=125452&key=user_uploads/1654391/70f87e0f-de8e-4d46-8738-7d0416c0a7d1)

* **It plugs into your stack.** Give it an MCP or API key, like your CRM, and it maps LinkedIn engagement to your deals and acts on it

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=125452&key=user_uploads/1654391/e38428a7-7662-4012-bba5-1bdeae40efcd)

## Why us

1. We research how B2B companies actually communicate on LinkedIn. Our [YC founder study](https://useimagine.ai/blog/the-distribution-of-linkedin-engagement) and our benchmark of 30,000+ people across 1,178+ B2B companies ([benchmark.useimagine.ai](https://benchmark.useimagine.ai)) go straight into the agent.
2. 100+ LinkedIn accounts run on Imagine, including teams at Rippling, Fondo, MarqVision, Frame Data & AI, Eragon and Paramify, and overall accounts connected on Imagine have published 4,100+ posts this year with almost 18M impressions. At Frame Data & AI, 70 of 85 matchable CRM records had a direct connection to the content.
3. We grow with you. We’re a small team and we care a lot about every customer. MarqVision went from 1 to 7 seats, and companies like Rippling and Frame Data & AI each run 4 to 7 profiles with us.

## Our ask

* Book a demo: <https://useimagine.ai>
* See where your company ranks: <https://benchmark.useimagine.ai>
* Know a founder or first marketer who keeps saying they should post more? Intro us at [sky@imagineai.me](mailto:sky@imagineai.me)

Hey YC.

We just launched multi-member team content for B2B companies.

Most companies try LinkedIn GTM with one founder posting alone. It works, but it's slow. One voice. One network. Limited reach.

What actually moves the needle is coordinated team effort. Multiple executives posting aligned content, amplifying each other, creating a ripple effect across the org.

That's what we built.\
\
<https://youtu.be/vSiHQ7_aQiA>

**Ask:** B2B company doing sales-led growth? Book a demo at [imagineai.me](http://imagineai.me) or email [**sky@imagineai.me**](mailto:sky@imagineai.me)

**The Problem**

B2B buyers trust people, not logos. But most companies have zero content infrastructure.

Founders and execs are juggling product, sales, and fundraising. Content falls to the bottom. Hiring an agency costs $150K+ and takes months to onboard per person. Generic AI tools produce robotic content that damages your brand. And even when someone does post, there's no coordination across the team. Your CEO and VP of Sales are operating in silos instead of running coordinated campaigns.

**What's New**

1️⃣ **Multi-seat access with coordinated cadence.** Your whole leadership team posts through Imagine AI. Not just the CEO. VP Sales, VP Marketing, Head of GTM, whoever needs to be building their presence. Your CEO posts the vision, your VP of Sales posts the proof, your Head of Marketing posts the framework. Same theme, different angles, coordinated ripple cadence.

2️⃣ **100+ page Persona Reports for each person.** We go through transcripts, interviews, podcast appearances, posts, and conversations for every person on your team. The result reads more like a biography than a brief. That's why the content sounds like each person actually wrote it. Not a polished corporate version. Them.

3️⃣ **Dedicated Content Engineer per account.** Every client gets a real person who owns your strategy. They set the pace, coordinate your team's content cadence, and ensure what we ship makes sense for your business. A senior content strategist with an AI platform behind them.

4️⃣ **AI-powered analytics that track pipeline, not pageviews.** You can see which posts start real conversations with your ICP. Audience activation, conversation quality, inbound meeting requests. Actual numbers, not vibes.

5️⃣ **Cut content creation time by 95%.** Executive post creation reduced from 1 hour to 5 minutes. Content prep reduced from 8 hours to 30 minutes. Most clients spend 2-4 hours per month on the platform. The rest runs on its own.

**Our Traction**

Launched November 2025. Now serving 40+ paying B2B companies from pre-seed to publicly traded.

Clients include Rippling, Corgi Insurance, Campfire AI, Fondo, Paramify, and others.

📈 Results across all clients:

* **$31M** in revenue generated
* **431** qualified inbounds in 1 month for one client
* **$53K** inbound revenue in 1.5 weeks for another
* **12M** total impressions generated
* **10,400** hours saved so far

We built all of this because our customers kept asking for it. They wanted their whole team posting, but couldn't justify the time investment for each person.

Now they can.

Hey YC.

We're Sky and Neo from Imagine AI, and we build B2B content pipelines for companies doing sales-led growth.

**TL;DR:** We build high-fidelity personas that replicate how you think and write, then use them to handle your entire content pipeline: LinkedIn posts, strategic comments, GEO/SEO/category defining blogs. The result is content that drives qualified inbounds.

One client got 200 qualified inbounds in a month. Another landed a $5M deal from a single post. A third generated 40K in revenue from inbounds in 10 days.

https://youtu.be/SiAtXolPFmY

**The Problem**

B2B founders know content drives pipeline. But you're juggling product, sales, and fundraising. You don't have time to make B2B content. Hiring an agency costs $150K and takes months to onboard. Generic AI tools produce robotic content that damages your brand.

**Our Solution**

We don't just write posts for you. We perform content engineering to get you to content market fit.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94851&key=user_uploads/1654391/15084825-fe7a-42f5-a032-78c90d251f6a)

Here's what that means:

**Step 1: Build a high-fidelity persona** We extract everything about how you think, write, and sell from your transcripts, articles, and interviews. The result is a persona document literally the length of a Harry Potter book. This isn't surface-level voice cloning. It's deep context about your worldview, your clients' pain points, and your unique insights.

**Step 2: Content engineering to market fit** We use that persona to build your entire content pipeline: 4 LinkedIn posts per week, strategic comments on prospect posts, category defining blogs that rank. Then we optimize based on engagement data until we hit content market fit, where your content consistently drives qualified inbounds.

**Step 3: Measure what matters** We track qualified conversations, not vanity metrics. We closed 10M in revenue so far for our clients.

That's content market fit.

**Our Traction**

We launched in mid-July, now serve 30+ paying customers including 16 YC companies plus VCs, global franchises, and ghostwriting agencies (Conduit W24, Freya AI S25, AthenaHQ W25, Itworks, Fuwa Fuwa). Achieving minimum 30%-70% week to week growth.
